I have written Makefile in 3 public repositories, from 2014 to 2025; in 1 of them it is the main language.

What it was for: [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (2) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [pdf\_renderer](@/work/pdf-renderer.md); [el-magico-cache](@/work/el-magico-cache.md): Elixir Cache; [skull-nodejs](https://github.com/korczis/skull-nodejs): Node.js Skull.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses Makefile: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links Makefile to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
